record.question: Amphibians of the plant kingdom are
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Provisional ( Preliminary ) - 2025 Answer Key Paper-I..pdf
record.explanation: Bryophytes are called the amphibians of the plant kingdom because their life cycle involves both water and land. NIOS describes them as non-vascular plants; the term is a textbook analogy, not a claim that they are animals.
